"""Bind actual reviewed conclusions,tables and native galleries into the report."""
import html
import re
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1'
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert notes.is_file() and len(notes.read_text())>300
assert read(root/'native-viewing-v1.json')['primary_figures_covered']==72
assert read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')['status']=='pass'
tables=read(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json');figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
assert len(tables['cells'])==205 and figures['all_RGB_channels_checked']==54451200
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json')
assert execution['head_calls']==5364 and execution['recorded_owner_count']==11
text='# Clean-target flat anchor: V162 final quality\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and immutable sources](results/v162-flat-target-anchor-final-v1.json) · '
text+='[Native pixels, source ROIs, conditioning, exposure and checkpoint hashes](images/v162-flat-target-anchor-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='## Response and actual blank error\n\n'
text+='RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Response1 means the exact constructed mesh amplitude. Blank error measures actual target error; added blank RMS measures displacement from V143.\n\n'+tables['sections']['mesh']+'\n'
text+='## Quiet neighbors and coarse fields\n\n'+tables['sections']['quiet']+'\n'
dc=read(root/'quiet-DC-audit-v1.json')
text+='Quiet bias is averaged per RGB channel before its Euclidean RMS. The independent pixel audit verifies total squared = spatial squared + DC squared per case; means of RMS values do not share that identity.\n\n'
text+='| Prior | Method | Quiet DC RMS DN16 |\n| --- | --- | ---: |\n'
for item in dc['groups']:
    text+=f"| {item['prior']} | {item['method']} | {item['mean_DC_RMS_DN16']:.6f} |\n"
text+='\n'+tables['sections']['flat']+'\n'
text+='## Natural detail and ADC controls\n\n'+tables['sections']['photo']+'\n'+tables['sections']['ADC']+'\n'
text+='## Fixed native comparisons\n\n'
text+='Every cell is native 160×160; crop pixels are never resized. All RAW methods within each board share source coordinates, camera display transform, exposure and contrast. JPEG cells retain native sRGB8 without exposure/contrast changes. Both final raw/EMA endpoints of both heads are shown, with six retained V156/V157/V158/V159/V160 ordinary/V160 paired columns.\n\n'
text+='The main scene is DSCF3879 ISO6400 versus DSCF3880 ISO100 f/5.6. The fine cab mesh uses DSCF3842 versus DSCF3835 and both camera JPEGs. Aperture, shutter, moving subjects and processing differ: ISO100 views are qualitative references, not exact GT. All30 real score rows stay unscored.\n\n'
categories=[('mesh','Mesh and exact absence'),('mixed-quiet','Quiet neighbors beside edges'),
    ('flat','Standalone flats and slopes'),('photo','Natural photographic detail'),('real','Protected real GFX scenes')]
for kind,title in categories:
    text+=f'### {title}\n\n'
    for item in figures['images']:
        if 'triplet_source_board' in item or item['case']['kind']!=kind:continue
        name=Path(item['image']['path']).name
        text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, RAW exposure {item['exposure']:g}, contrast {item['contrast']:g}.\n\n"
        text+=f"![{item['case']['id']}, native comparison](images/v162-flat-target-anchor-v1/{name})\n\n"
text+='### Noisy, restored, exact constructed GT triplets\n\n'
for item in figures['images']:
    if 'triplet_source_board' not in item:continue
    name=Path(item['image']['path']).name
    text+=f"![{item['case']['id']}; {item['panels'][1]['label']}; native triplet](images/v162-flat-target-anchor-v1/{name})\n\n"
text+='## Training, architecture and validation\n\n'
text+='Two fresh identical 124,397-parameter / 46-tensor harmonic-context heads use the same V160 cache and exact V161 initialization/base objectives. Only flat-target anchor weight 0 versus 0.25 changes. A detached per-channel 17×17 clean-target range at most 1 DN16 defines eligibility, with truncated neighborhoods at borders. The loss uses stable pseudo-Huber output-minus-target RGB error in fixed 16 DN16 units. Its whole-image denominator weights sparse masks proportionally; inherited domain weights apply. Selected weak gradients retain actual target values. This is training supervision, not an inference gate or calibrated uncertainty. Targets/masks/pair fields never enter the model forward.\n\n'
text+='The control exactly reproduces every V161 harmonic trace row and final raw/EMA/Adam state; all 1,644 actual control predictions replay byte-exact before archive storage is reused. The candidate retains 1,644 new external arrays. All 88 neural source files remain unchanged. Historical comparator columns mix data/loss/architecture changes; only the current matched contrast isolates the new anchor weight.\n\n'
text+='The reused V160 cache contains 4,000 frames: 1,382 present/background pairs and 1,236 ordinary frames from 2,618 scene/patch instances. Its 486 photo pairs visit 268 free-photo IDs; 234 reduce contrast and 245 use reviewed ROIs. Geometry precedes area 2 after bin 4; optical blur is zero. All 18 held-out IDs and protected captures/JPEGs/siblings remain excluded. V162 creates no new sources/noise or parent/DINO predictions. [V160 construction evidence](paired-response.md) preserves its original accounting failure and explicit 23-batch adoption.\n\n'
text+='156 CPU checks pass, including 17 new independent mask/loss/adjoint, border, coverage, sub-DN detail, shared pair error and batch-independence tests. Genuine 8+2 model/EMA/Adam/RNG restoration passes; first 10 complete smoke/train rows match exactly. CUDA parity covers 28 archived contexts / 56 calls and all CFAs/native 256/384/512/768. Ten additional leaf-output backwards check actual masks/losses/gradients against independent NumPy arithmetic; these are not neural forwards. Four strict endpoint loads and 92 finite Adam states at 1,000 pass. All 1,000 control trace rows match V161.\n\n'
routing=read(root/'training-routing-summary-v1.json')
for item in routing['groups']:
    if item['ADC_only']:continue
    text+=f"`{item['arm']}`: {item['norms_over_one']}/{item['batches']} supervised batches clip; pre-clip norm median {item['norm_median']:.6f}, maximum {item['norm_maximum']:.6f}.\n\n"
text+='The 100 zero-gradient ADC batches advance Adam/EMA clocks. Gradient norms describe optimization pressure; they do not isolate the cause of a quality change.\n\n'
audit=read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')
text+=f"The independent audit checks {audit['scalar_checks']:,} scalars across 4,686 rows and {audit['Decimal_reductions']} Decimal reductions; maximum scalar difference is {audit['maximum_scalar_difference']:.3g}. All 72 native images / 24 triplets were actually viewed in 18 original-detail sheets; 54,451,200 RGB channels were independently checked.\n\n"
text+='Actual scientific work is 5,364 head calls: 56 parity, 20 discarded smoke, 2,000 training and 3,288 main review. These evaluate 11,424 head images. Ten numerical leaf-output backwards and separate CPU tests are outside neural counts. All 1,644 new candidate arrays / 4.421 GiB stay external; 1,644 control outputs replay exactly before archive adoption. All ten original scientific controllers/workers plus the independent mask auditor are terminal, with no scientific failure or restart. The auxiliary readiness-verifier stale-path failure/source and corrected revision2 remain preserved. New local/external reserves are 60/152 GiB plus 0.5 GiB projected margin; old evidence is retained. Originals and `/mnt/dataz` are unused.\n\n'
text+='## Actual training-mask coverage\n\n'
text+='An independent streaming NumPy audit recomputes all 1,000 actual GPU mask fingerprints/counts from original clean RGB. Mean batch fraction reflects the loss denominator; pixel-weighted fraction accounts for mixed native context sizes. ADC masks are recorded but their total supervised loss remains zero. Eligibility describes a training weight, not a flat-safety or quality result.\n\n'
text+='| Domain | ADC only | Batches | Mean batch eligible fraction | Pixel-weighted eligible fraction |\n| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'
for g in read(root/'training-mask-audit-v1.json')['groups']:
    text+=f"| {g['domain']} | {g['ADC_only']} | {g['batches']} | {g['mean_batch_fraction']:.6f} | {g['pixel_weighted_fraction']:.6f} |\n"
text+='\n[Original protocol](results/v162-flat-target-anchor-v1/original-protocol.md) · [Immutable preparation](results/v162-flat-target-anchor-preparation-v1.json) · [Preserved auxiliary failure](results/v162-readiness-verifier-failure-v1.json) · [Independent publication verification](results/v162-flat-target-anchor-publication-verification-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='## Photographic credits\n\nDerived native targets/crops retain the respective source licenses; transformations include linearization, area binning and exposure/contrast changes. Source IDs and ROIs are in the manifest.\n\n| Source | Author | License |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n'
credits={}
for case in read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']:
    if case['kind']=='photo':
        credit=case['source']
        while 'author' not in credit:credit=credit['source']
        credits[credit['sha1']]=credit
assert len(credits)==18
for s in credits.values():
    author=html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]*>','',s['author'])).replace('|','\\|').replace('\n',' ')
    text+=f"| [{s['title']}]({s['page_url']}) | {author} | [{s['license']}]({s['license_url']}) |\n"
text+='\n## Fixed component checkpoints\n\n'
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
    text+=f"- `{label}`: `{read(binding['path'])['export']['sha256']}`.\n"
target=repo/'docs/flat-target-anchor.md';target.write_text(text)
receipt=root/'human-report-builder-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,{'status':'built-from-actually-reviewed-notes-and-audited-tables','report':ref(target),'notes':ref(notes),
    'table_bindings':ref(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json'),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
print('Built actual final quality report with205 score cells,10 quiet-DC cells and72 native images')
